ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$, as shown in figure 2, $OE$ and $OD$ bisect $\angle AOC$ and $\angle BOC$ respectively. If $\angle BOC = 40^\circ$, find the measure of $\angle EOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle EOD = \angle EOC - \angle COD$ \\
= $\frac{1}{2}\angle AOC - \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC$ \\
= $\frac{1}{2}(\angle AOB + \angle BOC) - \frac{1}{2}\angle BOC$ \\
= $\frac{1}{2}(90^\circ + 40^\circ) - \frac{1}{2} \times 40^\circ$ \\
= $65^\circ - 20^\circ$ \\
= $\boxed{45^\circ}$
